svg.title: KB-E2B6: how it works
svg.desc: Up to 2 backlit rotary encoders and 6 backlit push buttons plug into the 45 x 35 mm KB-E2B6 board; one USB cable to any host, which sees a USB keyboard. Configure once in the local web configurator; optionally map keys to Android actions with Key Mapper.
svg.text: Car head unit • PC • Phone • Robot

g.text: Used wherever a control is set to “Default”
CW: Arrow Down · CCW: Arrow Up · Push…
Short: Play / Pause · Long: Next track

svg.text: Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera • runs locally
Map keys to almost any Android action
